I Left California… 34 Hours Later I Was in India | Guru Mann Vlog
34 hours, multiple airports, a long flight, and one journey from my home in California to India!
In this vlog, take the entire journey with me as I leave California, head to San Francisco International Airport, board my flight, and finally arrive in India before making my way to Chandigarh.
From packing my bags at home to airport moments, airplane food, life onboard, the long travel hours, and finally stepping into India — I’m taking you behind the scenes of my journey.
